text:
Avery: heads up — apiserver p95 spiking in us-west2 since 11:03 UTC, several leader-election events and GPU provisioner queue growing. seeing attach latencies >4s and controller-manager failing to bind pods. dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/ctrlplane/us-west2
SRE-Bot: alert: APISERVER_LATENCY_HIGH us-west2 — severity: high — triggered 2026-03-20T11:04:12Z
Raj: ACK, pulling logs now. do we have rollback for the kube-proxy canary? last deploy was 04:50 UTC.
Oliver: pasted kube-controller-manager logs: `E0320 11:03:58.123 controller.go:456] failed to acquire lease: timed out waiting for leader lease` and `error attaching volume: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded`
Sophie: noticed NAT gateway SNAT table was near capacity earlier — could be conn churn. NAT metrics: snat_conn_count > 1.2M
Avery: GPU provisioner queue length: 92 pending, avg wait 75s, spike correlates with apiserver p95
Ken: short-term: can we route gpu-provision requests to eu-west1? capacity there is available. also propose scaling controlplane from 3->5 for us-west2 to ease elections.
Raj: running `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system apiserver -o wide` — endpoints look healthy but kube-proxy logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` to controlplane
SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: kube-proxy-canary v1.25.3 rolled out to 30% in us-west2 at 04:51 UTC
Oliver: ok rollback canary to 0%? `kubectl rollout undo ds/kube-proxy -n kube-system --to-revision=1` — can someone approve? @Sophie
Sophie: approve. do it and watch leader-election metric.
Avery: doing rollback now. will scale controlplane after rollback if still bad. posting steps in #incidents if we escalate.
SRE-Bot: action: rollback initiated by Avery at 11:08:42Z
Avery: rollback applied. monitoring... apiserver p95 down to 210ms after 30s. provisioner queue dropping to 12.
Ken: nice. follow-up: need to increase NAT pool and add connection tracking alerts. create a ticket and tag networking.
Raj: filing ticket INF-2026-314 with notes and graphs. assigning to @Networking and @Infra.
Oliver: add hypothesis: kube-proxy change increased ephemeral conns and caused SNAT exhaustion leading to apiserver timeouts -> provisioner attach timeouts. add to postmortem.
Sophie: agree. I'll add runbook step to detect SNAT >80% and automatic failover to warm-nat.
Avery: thanks team. if anything flares, page team. :thumbsup:
